education.institution: Indian Institute of Technology, Roorkee (IIT Roorkee)

highlights: Designed and developed scalable web applications using React, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, and Firebase, focusing on performance, maintainability, and clean architecture.
Built responsive web interfaces with dynamic state management and asynchronous RESTful API integrations.
Implemented reusable component systems and optimized rendering performance to reduce unnecessary re-renders and improve UI responsiveness.
Developed and maintained 50+ interactive web-based applications using TypeScript and React, serving 2M+ active learners with 99.8% uptime.
Engineered high-performance UI systems with complex animations and real-time state updates, maintaining a smooth 60 FPS on low-end devices.
Improved application efficiency and rendering logic, optimizing memory usage and UI responsiveness across web clients.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams (Product Managers, UX Designers, Backend SDEs) in an Agile sprint cadence to ship 15+ feature releases on schedule.
Built a 3D arcade game using C#, focusing on smooth UI/UX and gameplay experience.
Implemented client-server communication with secure data handling.
Worked on performance optimization and UI polish for seamless gameplay.

projects.name: Amazon E-Commerce Store
highlights: Architected a production-style Amazon-inspired e-commerce web platform featuring dynamic product catalog rendering, multi-category search, and persistent cart management.
Optimized global state handling using Redux Toolkit and Context API, ensuring seamless checkout workflows and sub-100ms render response times.

projects.name: Gemini AI Chat Application
highlights: Developed a real-time conversational AI application integrating Google Gemini APIs with token streaming, prompt caching, and markdown parsing.
Engineered multi-session conversation persistence and state caching, allowing users to save, manage, and resume chat history seamlessly across sessions.
